family.description: This entry represents the C-terminal receptor binding domain of Tip attachment protein J from Escherichia phage lambda (GpJ) and similar bacterial and viral proteins. J attaches the virion to the host receptor LamB, inducing viral DNA ejection. This domain, which determines the host specificity of the phage, shows an immunoglobulin-like fold [[cite:PUB00155963],[cite:PUB00109155]]. Many of the proteins in this entry are annotated as fibronectin type III. This domain was previously known as DUF3672 and is normally found associated with [pfam:PF09327] and [pfam:PF13550].
family.name: Tip attachment protein J, C-terminal receptor binding domain
